decision_question: On four exact sanitized real-shadow debugging incidents, does adding the pinned Superpowers systematic-debugging skill to an otherwise identical Codex stack change deterministic root-cause-correct repair enough to justify a preregistered reversible owner action?

primary_estimand.name: root-cause-correct hidden acceptance
primary_estimand.description: Matched-condition difference in binary deterministic acceptance; activation, invalidity, critical failures, cost, and latency remain separate measurements or gates.
primary_estimand.aggregation: Prespecified favorable, unfavorable, and tied pair counts, with two-of-two favorable tasks required within a stratum and zero unfavorable pairs for selective routing eligibility.

conditions.label: Frozen strong Codex baseline
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference condition; no study skill is injected.

conditions.label: superpowers-systematic-debugging
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds only the exact source-locked systematic-debugging skill tree to B0.

contamination_notes: Public mechanics and activation task only; excluded from every effect count.
Private sanitized task, dossier, reference repair, and evaluator bytes remain outside Git.
Task prompts do not name the treatment skill or disclose the hidden causal invariant.
The pack is maintainer-authored after observing the originating incidents; it is not independent task selection.

budget.description: Both conditions share a 900-second and 30000 generated-token per-cell cap. The complete frozen schedule is eight scored calls with no model-outcome retry.

dimensions.rule: count output plus reasoning-output tokens and invalidate a cell above the cap
remove a container exceeding the per-cell timeout
execute the eight frozen cells at most once; a non-empty cell path blocks silent resume

adaptation_boundary.description: The exact upstream skill tree is used without content adaptation. No runner-up, prompt repair, task repair, or post-outcome threshold change is permitted.

selection_rules: Classify every complete matched pair as favorable, unfavorable, or tied from deterministic acceptance.

A stratum is selectively route-eligible only when both of its tasks are favorable, every treatment activated, every cell is valid, and there are zero unfavorable pairs and zero treatment critical failures.
At least two unfavorable pairs, any treatment critical failure, or treatment activation failure rejects the exact candidate on this stack; every other valid result remains optional.
Global installation is ineligible regardless of the observed result.
stop_rules: Stop after any invalid cell, credential persistence, fixture mutation, unsafe path, pack/hash drift, or failed pre-call authorization binding.
Do not retry model outcomes or replace an existing scored cell; ambiguous execution requires manual reconciliation outside this freeze.
Retain negative and invalid evidence; do not change tasks, evaluator, source, prompt, code, runtime, budget, schedule, or rules after freeze.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz authored the sanitized private tasks and evaluator, operates the runner, and owns the evidence interpretation and action policy.
